mobbin:1e4db417-5727-4669-950b-cfb4f457d.summary: The user opens Analytics, sets up a schedule-adherence report for one team member with a tolerance, loads the comparison table, then browses the audit, attendance, map and turnover reports.
steps: Home Dashboard: setup carousel and Needs Attention empty
Analytics home: category tiles, Shift Pulse 4/5, classic Pay Comparison
Welcome to Analytics: Analyze, View details, schedule-or-export pitches
Schedule adherence: filters and empty 'Select value on control to load data'
Team Member picker open with per-person counts
Adherence table: Shift vs Timesheet hours/cost; red Hour Difference
Shift audit: notice-time histogram and detail table
Attendance and absence: No shows, Late, Early percent and weekly lines
Geolocation map: clock in/out map and last refreshed time
Diversity and turnover: gender/age/tenure pies and people filters
steal: The welcome text offers three ways out: download a spreadsheet, print a PDF, or schedule the report to the people who need it (screen 3).
A tolerance (15 minutes) is chosen before the adherence data loads (screens 4 to 6).
Planned shifts and actual timesheets sit side by side, with differences in hours and cost shown in red (screen 6).
The Analytics home shows 'Shift Pulse' as a 4/5 average with a small trend line and a recent comment: a formative score with a narrative (screen 2).
avoid: The catalog of business-intelligence reports, with '+ Create report' and 'Make a copy', is built on Sigma. It goes against the plan of no deep report builders in the first version (screens 3 to 10).
mobbin:1e4db417-5727-4669-950b-cfb4f457d.fit: Reports: borrow the scheduled delivery, the comparisons of planned and actual use, and the formative pulse. Do not bring over the embedded report library.
